cells.tense: Right now the push and the feeling about it have caught up with each other, and that is where the direction comes from.
cells.act: dream it from what you have already lived
cells.ask: Picture next year once, built only out of days you have actually had — nothing borrowed from anyone. Keep it to yourself, and nothing gets arranged on the strength of it.
cells.core:
You are on the way somewhere and you are not guessing. Ask where this push came from and you would point at something you actually feel about it, not at a chart, and because the feeling and the direction are not arguing, the momentum carries you further than any plan alone would. You do not need a firm picture of how far you will go before you take the next stretch.

Your people keep exactly that kind of direction alive, and you have been feeding it — less by leaving your mark on it than by letting it leave its mark on you. When you think about the months ahead, build them out of what you have already done rather than out of fantasy, and let what you already believe carry the plan. Where there is no map, or an incomplete one, that is the register you were going to act in anyway.
cells.sheetLine: You know where you're going, and you know why.
cells.verb: carrying something forward into what comes next
cells.place: among what is shared, kept and handed on between people

cells.tense: Somewhere ahead there is a point past arrival, and this push is already past it before it gets to be written in.
cells.act: blend the two things instead of choosing one
cells.ask: With the people on this road, hold pushing on and stopping in the same hand for a moment. Add a bit of each until they sit level, correct it once, then walk away from the dial.
cells.core:
The push still works, but it has started going past what you set out for. You know the destination, and you are already worried past it — what breaks next, who stops showing up, which step of the thing fails. So more gets added ahead: one more push, one more safeguard against the next stretch, because the goal has stopped being a picture and has become something to survive.

Carrying the load longer is what let you lead where you were needed, and it can still be here, adjusted rather than dropped. With the people you share the road with, blend the forward step and the pause instead of choosing between them; neither one has to win. Add a little or take a little away, and sense the difference before you decide it was nothing.

cells.tense: The threshold is behind you and the step across it has not happened.
cells.act: let the thing end that is already over
cells.ask: Among your people there is one thing that has finished — a way you gather, a form, an old grip. Stop it this month, mark the end plainly once, and keep it shut. Nothing takes its place yet.
cells.core:
The push has stalled at a doorway you are standing in. Energy still goes toward the goal and no ground is gained; the wish is fully there and arrives nowhere, because what carried you to that point has run out. From outside, standing with your people is what your days seem to be, and the direction has gone quiet. This is not effort you need. Something among your people is over and is being held open anyway.

When this works, feeling and movement happen together — you want a thing and you are already walking. To get there, let one thing end that is already over. Close it, honor it, and keep it closed. Something among what you share has run its course; clear the space it leaves, once, and leave the spot empty for now.

cells.tense: Right now there is a pen moving that you will not sign, and that is true here too.
cells.act: stop holding up the false thing and watch it come down
cells.ask: There is one thing among your people that stands because it keeps being propped. Stop propping it for a stretch — no announcement, no repairs — and watch what happens without stepping in.
cells.core:
You are moving toward something among your people, and the movement gets scored as the group's rather than yours. What surprises you at the reading is the goal, not the work — you recognize what was pushed for, and not the pushing, including the parts no one else would have done. You see the page; you do not see your hand on it.

Which structures you keep standing is between you and the room. When this works, what you want and what you do run together. Let one old structure fall that could not hold: stop propping it, stop guarding the record, and watch what you kept standing come down. What falls was going to fall. Stand in the gap it leaves, and do not rebuild it yet.

attempts.check: The seat is Culture, shared meaning carried between people, and the ask sits in that seat while the medicine is the person's own act — the one place the record risks straining is the natural reading that the acts are communal forms, when they are the person's own acts done near their people. A Reader can say with cause that tradition is not a list of customs anyone issues, and the cell must not imply that. The ask survives being wrong: if the read misses entirely, the act is one small camera-visible move toward what is already shared and can be done quietly at home. The sentence that serves me more than them would be any line about customs and habits that dresses my own idea of Culture as something the card said; I avoid it.

attempts.check: The seat is Culture, shared meaning carried between people, and the risk in my draft was imagery and idiom — the room, the shape, the map, and 'back in balance' all dressed the map as the person's life, and none of it came from them. A Reader could fairly say tradition is not a set of customs anyone issues, and three of my asks were one bounded thing with a clock, which turns a life into a list. The asks survive being wrong: each is one small visible move that can be done quietly, and if my read misses entirely the person still learns something about what they carry and where they stand. The sentence that serves me more than them was the line about what needs rebuilding — it flattered my own picture of Culture instead of saying the plain thing.
